name: n-Track Studio
blurb: n-Track Studio is the powerful digital audio workstation (DAW) for musicians, producers, and creators of all levels.
description:
n-Track Studio is the powerful digital audio workstation (DAW) for musicians, producers, and creators of all levels. Record, edit, mix, and master audio and MIDI with ease.

Make professional-quality music using built-in tools like the Step Sequencer, Piano Roll, Drum Pads and more. Add effects such as vocal tuning, amps, EQ, reverb, and limiter to shape your sound.

Play and compose with over 400 virtual instruments and 15GB of included royalty-free sounds. You can also create your own instruments with the built-in sampler. Use the AI-powered MixSplit feature to separate full songs into individual tracks for remixing or editing.

Collaborate with musicians around the world through the integrated Songtree community. Whether you're recording vocals or a full band, n-Track Studio supports multi-channel audio devices and works with popular plugin formats like VST2, VST3 and CLAP.
